name: a_stock_profile_lookup
description: A-share company profile lookup. Host adapters verify stock identity, industry, listing date, share capital, market cap, F10 profile, and basic quarterly snapshot fields.

user_message.description: Original user request. Preserve company names, symbols, relative-date hints, requested fields, source constraints, and freshness requirements verbatim.

entity_name.description: Candidate A-share entity/company name inferred from the request; adapters must verify the subject.

stock_code.description: A-share stock code or symbol hint from the user or upstream resolver. Candidate only; adapters verify the listed security.

market.description: Candidate A-share market hint. Host adapters normalize and verify the final market.

profile_fields.description: Company profile fields requested by the user. Missing or unsupported fields must be reported explicitly.

freshness.description: Freshness constraints from the user. Host adapters must verify source timestamps, trading-day status, and delayed/realtime availability.

mode.description: Freshness mode such as latest_available, realtime, delayed_ok, explicit_trade_date, or recent_period.

relative_date_hint.description: Relative date phrase from the user, kept verbatim for freshness and trading-day guard.

trade_date.description: Explicit A-share trade date requested by the user or host policy.

as_of.description: Timestamp or date at which the source evidence should be considered current.

require_realtime.description: Whether delayed market data is unacceptable for this request.

require_latest_trading_day.description: Whether the response must use the latest trading day available for the verified market.

source_policy.description: Optional host/source policy hint such as official-only, delayed-data acceptable, or provider preference. This is not an authorization source.
